title: Redaction discipline when adding request logging
groundTruth: Every handler in src/handlers.js logs its event via log.info(name, { reqId: req.reqId }) and includes nothing else from the request in the log line -- no user ids, emails, or passwords (docs/CONVENTIONS.md).
failureMeasured: Following the strong generic instinct that good logs carry context -- logging user ids, emails, or request bodies when asked to add request logging -- instead of the documented house redaction rule, which is the opposite of the generic best practice.
fairness: The redaction rule, its rationale (a third-party log sink outside the compliance boundary), and a worked example are stated verbatim in docs/CONVENTIONS.md, which fixture/README.md points to in bold on the first screen. The prompt names neither the document nor the rule -- only that the handlers log nothing.
note: EXPERIMENTAL / not yet gate-cleared.
